name: PolkaDot Mushroom Chocolate Bars | 1000mg Magic Blend
description:
PolkaDot Mushroom Chocolate Bars

PolkaDot Mushroom Chocolate Bars are a perfect blend of rich, creamy chocolate and premium psilocybin mushrooms. Known for their great taste, smooth texture, and reliable potency, these bars have become a favorite choice for those seeking a delicious and discreet way to enjoy mushrooms.

Benefits of PolkaDot Mushroom Chocolate Bars

• 
Improved Mood & Euphoria: Many users report feelings of happiness, relaxation, and emotional balance.

• 
Enhanced Creativity & Focus: The psilocybin chocolate can boost imagination and help with deeper thinking.

• 
Heightened Sensory Perception: Colors, sounds, and music often feel more vivid and immersive.

• 
Convenient Microdosing Option: It is easy to break into squares for controlled and consistent dosing.

• 
Delicious Taste: Enjoy the benefits of mushrooms without the earthy, bitter flavor.

Ingredients:

The Polkadot Chocolate Bars are made from high-quality ingredients that prioritize both flavor and health.The primary components include:

Belgian Milk Chocolate: Rich and creamy, this chocolate couverture serves as the perfect base for our mushroom blend.

Amanita Muscaria Extract (Muscimol Isolate): Each piece contains 0.5mg of muscimol, providing a unique psychoactive experience.

Proprietary Polka Blend: This blend includes organic functional mushrooms such as:

• Organic Lion’s Mane (Hericium erinaceus)

• Organic Reishi (Ganoderma lucidum)

• Organic Turkey Tail (Trametes versicolor)

• Organic Cordyceps (Cordyceps militaris)

Effects of Consuming Polkadot Chocolate Bars

The effects of consuming Polkadot Mushroom Chocolate Bars can vary based on individual tolerance and dosage. Generally, users report:

Many experience a gentle uplift in mood, making it a delightful treat for social gatherings or personal enjoyment.

Also, the calming properties of Amanita muscaria can lead to a soothing experience, ideal for winding down.

In addition, users often find that microdosing enhances their creative thinking and problem-solving abilities.

Are Polkadot Mushroom Chocolate Bars safe?

Yes they are safe when consumed responsibly by adults over 21 years old. Always consult with a healthcare provider if you have concerns.
